Else if NOT LowWet -> Fill true
Else retain previous Fill.

- FILLING: Fill true. Transitions to STOPPED if SensorFault or Inhibit or HighWet. Stays FILLING if low false and no stop? Actually if middle (LowWet&!HighWet&!Inhibit) retain true.
